title: Online earning: Lets start today  |Urdu| |Prof Dr Javed Iqbal|
description: Answers to the questions about online earning. Please follow the link for the online sessions: http://bitly.ws/uESW  We are supporting the efforts of "The better life", as they are trying to contribute the lives of people in a positive way.  https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC-xO3j1THVdz5V8Rftou-jw Prof Dr Javed Iqbal is a surgeon with special interest in laparoscopic and cancer surgery. His professional qualifications are FCPS, FRCS, FACS, FICLS, MCPS-HPE. He is one of the pioneers of laparoscopic surgery in the region. He has trained more than 50 surgeons formally as their supervisor and thousands more who have worked with him in various capacities during his four decades long professional journey. He is an official mentor of Royal College of Glasgow and International Course Director of American College of Surgeons for Advance Trauma Life Support (ATLS). He is a well known medical educationist and has been a part of College of Physicians and Surgeons, University of Health Sciences and Nishter Medical University as faculty of medical education.He is on the reviewers penal of various index medical journals. He has more than twenty five research publications on his credit along with a book on surgery entitled "The Operative Surgery"He is a published poet, shot story writer, critic and broadcaster. His current areas of effort are teaching and training of soft skill at various national and international fora. He is very active on social media and his team runs a very well subscribed youtube channel covering versatile topics& interests. He is regularly being invited on national & international TV shows for his intellectual contribution. He is an influential speaker. Millions of people are getting benefit from his videos on medical education, FCPS training, parenting, relationships, human wellbeing and various other social issues.

asr.full_text: Asslam-u-Alaikum In the description of this video there is given a link where Huzaifa will take online teaching & coaching classes so please follow that link Asslam-u-Alaikum Last time we posted a video which title was Online Earning there were many comments there & many questions were asked so I felt a need to ask the answer to those questions that you have taught 1 crore people, both Pakistan and other countries. In fact, many people from our neighboring countries have asked me to tell them how they can learn in India. So, I will ask you how people can learn from you. Thank you so much, Dr. Sahib. The videos that I have been making till now, I never gave a recorded section. I used to never give recorded sessions in my videos But I have seen many students in lockdown who can't access internet in order to take live sessions Main thing is live sessions We take live sessions after every 2 months But recorded files are uploaded on a YouTube channel And all the information related to that course that what is the course and where is it located all those information will be available on this channel You will get a notification on which course information you will get Sir, I understood that you are telling us that our channel Prof. Dr. Jawed Iqbal and put a title on it, Digital Marketing. And we will decide a day and we will tell our viewers that that video will be uploaded on that particular week. So what do you think should be one video it every two weeks on the channel? No. Your CAUSE is make people easy on the internet. There can be no one who looks at our channel every day as much as others. Today is Tuesday, is it possible that we will upload the first video on the next Tuesday? Yes, it is possible. And we will upload a video on every Tuesday and there will also be a follow up. This video will be in a separate playlist in our YouTube channel It will be called Digital Marketing. The second question asked repeatedly was that, if somebody says that his skill level is very basic in IT and he wants to start online or digital marketing from today So explain a little bit of algorithm for that if your level is at zero and if not then how can you reach 100 level zero level you'll reach 100 level so its very important to know what are the first thing we should keep in mind is what are the things which you have to do today and on videos we won't waste time if i will comment on this on other places you can find this kind of videos on videos there you have burden of lecture So at least we don't waste your time then our algorithm is that in few videos if we talk about photo shop video then in five videos and that too in 15-15 minutes you become expert of photo shop so if you watch 5 videos and become expert and you have level zero then you are starting from level zero our first lecture is for the one whoever has just turned on button then first time front of him computer screen gets is seeing a screen for the first time. Abdullah, do you want to add anything on this point? No, it's the key part. If you don't have an interest in it, then you won't be able to learn it, so then you have to earn it instead. If you are interested in this then first of all, read your own interests Search for online fields, which are available on Google on which things you are interested It can be graphic design, social media marketing, or even content writing. So, search your own interest and according to it, watch videos on Youtube or get data from Google Learn some basic things from it And then through his course or the videos he has been showing you, you can learn further. I'll explain it in another way, we have to work really hard. Like, at the end, if we have a man now, he has a lot of money. You have to learn the basics. For example, you have so much money in your money, which we should try to earn. This is what I said. After that Huzayfa told me and Abdullah also this experience that he started earning at a very young age. When he studied in 7th grade, he said I earned 7200 rupees online when I was studying in 7th grade. When I was studying in 6th grade. He also told that in 6th and 7th grade he became a certified what did you say? He became a trainer and started earning money. He said that it is also important to tell that when in a young age there is not enough understanding and social wisdom and money starts coming to the person then there are some side effects. So when you will get involved in this work at a very young age then they also want to share their experience which is very important for us. And this is more important for us than what we have discussed till now. You must tell us about it. Yes, you are right. When we become independent, we consider that the success of parents is because he has started earning, It is okay that this is success, but it is not such success that is success for you in this world and in the hereafter. When you are independent, obviously if you are independent in your younger age, then you are an immature. We never say that the maturity level of a small child is as much as he is mature, That he is like that, which is 10 years older than him. We never achieve that maturity level unless we face the things which we are facing and the biggest thing is if you are getting the guidelines from behind sometimes you are trusted more and you become independent and do things which you regret for the rest of your life The biggest example is in college or school life the kids start smoking. It is a very bad habit at that time. But when they feel that they have become independent, then this is important. When they see other people smoking, they think it is important that they are independent. It is necessary to smoke for us. Whereas this does not happen. There are many productive jobs. They can do such things instead. And most of the people do this. As we were talking just now, if you come to earn money then it is wrong and most of the people are doing this work whose purpose is to earn money earning money should not be the purpose to be successful should be the purpose and behind it you should have a goal that why am I becoming successful what benefit am I getting from this You should focus on is that your work should not be your job but your passion. This is the basic thing regarding online earning especially. If you are working with your job as a burden then you will not be able to learn. Abdullah, it is a very real challenge that you cannot take money from your family and you have opportunities to spend on useless things or wrong things. This hierarchy of need that Marcelo has said is the basic need of a person, the needs of the body. So keep this ladder on your feet because we have to do a lot of big work together which is bigger than money. I have understood that the way to avoid this is that all those who become independent then at least find some kind of mentor for yourself so that they are under some umbrella and that mentor is your friend or elder who doesn't judge you or who you can even tell your faults so if we will search around then we will find a mentor who has a unique word in Urdu, who will be on our shoulders So it is very important whatever we do, In it, you see being independent is very good But being independent is also one destination There is a other destination on top of goal above it which is positive interdependence There are three steps to this. One is dependent and one is independent But being independent is not the goal. Positive interdependence is the ultimate goal in which you work as a team with each other So that was it. What else did you want to say? few of us are able to recover from the mistake and re-define the goals of our lives without this mistake many people become dump in a way and forget their purpose in University because this Western culture can never gives you time to succeed at least it gives you happiness with time but, on long distance it can never give you any purpose or thought so, when we are in university long life. Unistty has been a very positive source of innovation in the field of dating, which has been very popular in our state for several decades. it does not mean you can achieve your living only independent means you will not need any guidelines from other as long you are not full then your parents will not blame you independence is not necessary that we should not take money you are independent when you are living 100 kms from your house and you know that this work is wrong and you do not want to do this work. The day you understand the difference between good and bad, you will be completely independent. Great! One more thing to add. Yes, sure. because you have an interaction with people. So, it is also related to many scammers. I have read about it myself. So, in that, they try to... So, explain scammers to us. It is related to scammers. They do it in such a way that you invest here or work with us. Their aim is not to loot money. So, for that also, as sir was saying, we need guidance or mentor who much flexible in their approach. You have mentioned in detail how our mentor used the word Dating. That's a solution that i have now in my mind. the more people go towards bad things if their being isn't educated In this relationship I think of a guideline for myself and I want to share with you. It is a small struggle not only for this work but everything including the small job that I have to complete Whatever work we are to do We think for once that what results can one get If we are going to do something, we should think about what the result can be. Stephen Coffey's 7 habits are looking the end first. Think about the result first. I am going to do one thing, what will be the result of this? If we think about this, option A, B and C will come to our mind. And it will be easy? If you think about that then option a, option b, option c will also come to our mind which will make it easy for us to choose So, thank you very much Is there anything else I have missed? This is to say… The people who are here who we see coming to the university just since they are back from their laptop to do their work I am not saying that I am this is not the right approach. We are basically going to create something for people and we are going to express the advice given by Allah. As a result, the money will come automatically. like if you buy cow, then why do you buy cow? to get milk from it, you ask how much milk cow gives cow also has cow dung which makes cow dung and used as indian but no one ask how much cow dung cow gives someone ask like this, they knows that when the cow that gives milk comes, the cow will come on its own. So in this way, I am a very rude example. But you see that the milk that needs to be taken out is of high purpose. And cow dung is its money. I am not saying that cow dung is not usable. It is also used, it makes indan, it makes hay. But its value is the same as milk and its value. So you should make your passion your source of income Yes, definitely We are starting this Doctor Sahib's Channel in IT Only because we want to benefit the immature and youth For them, there should be something that gives them proper guidelines And not in a wrong way Because I also have a lot of work in my field Abdullah brother has a lot of work in my field. I also have a lot of work with Abdullah. So, we know who are working well in Pakistan and who are scammers. So, we will keep making videos on some things which are progressive and good for youth. All the information related to IT will be easily available to you from this channel. And, there will be authentic information There will be no promotion related information There will be only information that will benefit you No other person, product or company will benefit from this Okay, I will end my talk here So, one video will be a video which will be about our IT and digital marketing so i pray to Allah that He will create sincerity in our intentions and if there is any failure in our intentions or any worldly benefit in our intentions then may will forgive us and will lead us towards right path and for all the time we have lived we will live a useful life the life Allah want's of us and the life that prophet has told us May Allah give us the strength to do it. Thank you!
